description: Three fists with the right hand, each held 6-7 s and moved around, then opened: knuckles toward the camera (2-9.5 s), side-on with the thumb toward the camera (17-24.5 s), and palm toward the camera (29.7-37 s). Each should engage once as a fist, and nothing should engage as a pinch. Side-on, MediaPipe often reports a second, smaller ghost hand on top of the real one, sometimes with the same label and listed first; around 22-23 s it loses the real hand for about half a second and only ghosts are reported. Recorded from a live webcam at 320x240 via HandwaveWidget.hands_data (every other frame, ~28 fps); labels are as the tracker sees them.
